LanguageData.Geigercounter.ResearchDesc: Rimatomics offers portable devices which can be used for detecting ionizing radiation.\n\nAll colonists will be equipped with radiation detectors so that ionizing events will produce audible clicks. The amount of exposure will be displayed as text, with a strength ranging from 0 to 5.
LanguageData.Geigercounter.ResearchDescDisc: All colonists are now equipped with radiation detectors. Ionizing events will produce audible clicks, and the exposure amount will be displayed as text with a strength ranging from 0 to 5.
LanguageData.RadSuits.ResearchDesc: Protect your colonists from radiation with shielded clothing. Radiation suits prevent contact with radioactive particles and gases, reducing exposure to ionizing radiation.
LanguageData.RadSuits.ResearchDescDisc: You can now produce your own radiation and MOPP suits at Rimatomics machining tables.
LanguageData.NuclearResearch.ResearchDesc: Before your colonists can build full-scale Rimatomics nuclear reactors and other nuclear-based technologies, they must first train with and study them using a research reactor.
LanguageData.NuclearResearch.ResearchDescDisc: Additional research related to nuclear power is now available.
LanguageData.NuclearReactor.ResearchDesc: The Rimatomics nuclear power plant is a scalable design with the ability to run multiple reactors, turbine generators, and cooling solutions in a single system.\n\nEach reactor is capable of producing more than 200kW of power when fully fueled. Reactors can also be used for plutonium production.
LanguageData.NuclearReactor.ResearchDescDisc: You are no longer limited to building one of each part of the reactor system. You can expand by adding more cores, turbines, and coolers.\n\n Additional research related to nuclear power is now available.
LanguageData.Plutonium.ResearchDesc: Extract plutonium from used nuclear fuel, which can be used to create MOX fuel rods, radioisotope thermoelectric generators (RTGs), and nuclear weaponry. The process requires chemfuel and produces drums of depleted uranium and nuclear waste.\n\nThe amount of material that will result from reprocessing is based on the conversion ratio of the fuel, with a maximum of 0.6x using normal reactors and 1.2x using advanced breeder reactors.
LanguageData.Plutonium.ResearchDescDisc: You can now reprocess spent nuclear fuel.\n\nThe use of protective apparel is recommended when loading used fuel into the processor.
LanguageData.AdvReactor.ResearchDesc: Research advanced breeder reactors, which can generate more fissile material than they consume, and the Zeus turbine generator, which is capable of generating up to 1MW of power at full capacity.
LanguageData.AdvReactor.ResearchDescDisc: You can build additional advanced breeder reactors and Zeus turbines.
LanguageData.RTG.ResearchDesc: The Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator (RTG) is portable electrical generator that uses an array of thermocouples to convert heat released by radioactive decay into electricity.\n\nThis generator has no moving parts and provides a constant 1200W of power, however it will leak radiation if damaged.
LanguageData.RTG.ResearchDescDisc: You can now build RTGs, which can be reinstalled and provide a constant 1200W of power.\n\nWarning: RTGs will leak radiation if damaged!
LanguageData.ICBM.ResearchDesc:
The RA-1776b Liberator is a self-contained, all-in-one, strategic missile manufacturing and launching facility.

The Liberator has a five missile magazine and allows the stockpiling of nuclear arms.

The missiles require plutonium that has been reprocessed from spent nuclear fuel.
